in_sanskrit.name: Ashcar
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God of Ash
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ashcar एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Ashcar is a name derived from Sanskrit, which is a combination of the words 'Ash' (god of ash) and 'Car' (chariot). It is believed that this name was given to a divine being who rode a chariot made of ash. This name carries the spiritual meaning of purification and renewal, as ash is a symbol of transformation and renewal in Hinduism.
